issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the attribute as type int, while the reference implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares it as long. This mismatch can confuse students about which type to use for the field and its getter/return type when they implement SealSaloon.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement UML and description to declare totalOrders as long, or change the reference implementation to use int (private int totalOrders = 0;) and adjust the getter return type accordingly. Choose the int variant if the UML is authoritative for the exercise; choose long if very large order counts are expected and document this in the problem statement.
